QCitizens, mag-ingat sa sunog!🔥🚒🧯

Paalala po ng Lokal na Pamahalaan ngayong #FirePreventionMonth, maging alerto at maingat para maiwasan ang panganib na dulot ng sunog sa ating buhay at komunidad.

Kung mayroong sunog sa inyong lugar, tumawag sa Quezon City Helpline 122 o sa pinakamalapit na fire station.

Narito ang ilang #FireSafetyTips kung paano maiiwasan ang sunog.

#StaySafeQCitizens

data.text:
AN APPEAL FOR THE SAFETY AND CONVENIENCE OF ALL FILIPINOS 
March 3, 2026

Due to the recent rise in fuel prices and the serious concerns about air and noise pollution, I am appealing to people to reconsider organizing motorcades and vehicle caravans/parades as a form of protest. These events not only lead to higher fuel costs but also worsen air pollution and increase traffic congestion, causing significant inconvenience to everyone.

While I fully understand the desire to gather and express anger against the administration or show support to Former President Rodrigo Duterte, it is, however, more important to be mindful of how these activities impact others and the environment. I encourage exploring alternative ways to come together that are less disruptive and more sustainable, since we have a long way to go in making the world listen to the failures of government administration in the Philippines. At the same time, we must confront the crisis of loss of jobs of OFWs coming home, as well as the sharp increase in the cost of food and other essential commodities.

I call on all Local Government Units (LGUs) to permanently ban motorcades and vehicle caravans/parade whether for celebrations, festivals, or political intent. 

Let us all do our part to keep our roads and our country safer, cleaner, and more efficient for everyone.

Thank you.

SARA Z. DUTERTE
Vice President of the Philippines
